title: e2e interactivity oracle: local injectRufflePlayer omits autoplay:'on' (3 false diffPixels=0 failures)
description:
QA sweep at main d8cd458. apps/desktop/e2e/interactivity.spec.ts has its OWN local injectRufflePlayer (line 79) that calls player.ruffle().load({ data: bytes, allowScriptAccess: true }) WITHOUT autoplay:'on' or unmuteOverlay:'hidden'. Per CLAUDE.md (and prior task 0928 which fixed this exact issue in the SHARED RufflePlayer helper): in headless Chromium with a suspended AudioContext, Ruffle's default autoplay:'auto' shows a play-button overlay and never calls play(), so the timeline never advances after a click — frame-advance interactivity tests then see before==after and diffPixels=0. Affected tests (consistently FAIL, reproduced twice):
- interactivity.spec.ts:463 'button release event: click advances frame and changes visible color' — diffPixels=0, Expected >100
- interactivity.spec.ts:629 'button press event: mousedown advances frame and changes visible color' — diffPixels=0, Expected >100
- interactivity.spec.ts:907 'Capstone: basic game interaction › dot catcher: button click advances frame red→green' — diffPixels=0, Expected >100
PROOF this is harness-not-defect: the equivalent on(release) oracle in apps/desktop/e2e/button-roundtrip.spec.ts:495 (which uses autoplay:'on') PASSES with pixelDiff=10000, proving on(release)/DefineButton2 publish + Ruffle click works end-to-end. The standalone capstone-0519.spec.ts (keyboard-driven, autoplay:'on') also PASSES. Same-spec tests that don't need post-click ticking PASS (onClipEvent(load), Up-only HIT_TEST structural). Fix: add autoplay:'on' and unmuteOverlay:'hidden' to interactivity.spec.ts's injectRufflePlayer load opts (mirror button-roundtrip/keyboard/fla-roundtrip helpers). Repro: cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/interactivity.spec.ts --grep 'button release|button press|dot catcher'.
